text:
julia: Heads-up - small but noisy spike in mTLS verify failures for us-east-2 around 2026-03-18T14:22Z. Logs show 'short certificate chain' and 'certificate verify failed'. Anyone on triage?
omar: Looking now. Rotator emitted 'issued' events but KMS shows UnwrapDenied for rotator-us-east2 at 2026-03-18T14:21:59Z. Seems like an authz gap.
rei: Correlating infra deploys... terraform PR #4521 merged yesterday tightened KMS roles. It appears the PR removed decrypt on the ca-key for a handful of region-scoped service accounts including rotator-us-east2.
julia: So rotator may have created the cert record but couldn't unwrap the CA key -> no private key to sign, proxies got incomplete chains. That explains the short-chain errors.
omar: Quick mitigation: re-add kms:Decrypt for rotator-sa and restart rotator in region. I can do a console quick-fix while we revert terraform if needed.
rotator-bot: Restart queued for rotator-us-east2.
rei: Applying console patch now to re-grant Unwrap/Decrypt to `serviceAccount:rotator-us-east2@redwood.iam`. ETA ~90s.
audit-bot: Terraform change linked: tf-4521 removed role binding on key `projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/ca/cryptoKeys/root` for `rotator-us-east2` at merge commit abcdef. KMS audit shows UnwrapDenied x 37.
rei: IAM change applied. KMS audit now shows Allow for rotator-us-east2.
omar: Restarting rotator: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/rotator --region=us-east-2`
rotator-bot: Restart triggered: rotator-us-east2 (pod/rotator-5c9d) -> rolling restart.
omar: After restart we see chain_unwrap success logs and chain_pushed events. Handshake success improved to ~78% immediately. Still a tail from proxies caching the earlier stub certs.
julia: Rolling edge proxies to evict cert caches: `kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy --region=us-east-2`.
omar: Edge proxies restarted, handshake failure rate dropped to 0.4% after 8m. Looks healthy.
rei: Root cause: terraform PR removed KMS unwrap perms for region rotator principal. Rotator emitted issuance before unwrap confirmation, so incomplete chains were pushed. Long cert cache TTL on some legacy proxies prolonged the impact.
julia: Action items: 1) Add a pre-apply CI guard to block removal of KMS unwrap/decrypt roles for principals tagged `rotator` or `cert-issuer`. 2) Change rotator: do not emit final 'issued' event until unwrap confirmed, or emit 'issuance_pending' and surface metric `issuance_pending_count`. 3) Add alert: KMS UnwrapDenied spike + issuance_pending > 5 -> page sec-oncall. 4) Default cert-cache TTL = 5m during rotation windows and document older proxies requiring shorter TTLs. 5) Auto-correlate TF change IDs with KMS audit entries in the console for faster root cause mapping.
rei: Also suggest a short-term guard in the console: if a TF plan removes bind on `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` for any principal with tag matching `rotator|cert-issuer`, require an explicit override with two approvals.
julia: Good. I'll file the postmortem ticket and the infra JIRA.
rei: Filed SEC-41107: "Terraform RBAC change removed KMS unwrap -> rotator issuance pending -> mTLS short-chain failures (us-east-2)" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-41107
omar: Minor follow-up: let's add a rotator metric `unwrap_latency_ms` and `unwrap_failure_rate` so we can build a runbook alert mapping directly to KMS UnwrapDenied.
julia: Agreed. Closing thread unless alerts reoccur. :thumbsup:
